faqs.question: What is nologin.tools?
faqs.answer: nologin.tools is a curated, verified directory of privacy-respecting online tools and utilities that work instantly without requiring user registration, accounts, or personal data collection.

faqs.question: How are tools verified on nologin.tools?
faqs.answer: Every tool is empirically vetted in the NoLogin Lab using the CADES 2.0 evaluation framework. We verify client-side data handling, zero-egress network behavior, and account-free functionality before approval.

faqs.question: Are the tools on nologin.tools free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes, every tool listed in the directory can be used for its core tasks without payment, credit card information, or account creation.

faqs.question: How can I embed a verification badge on my site?
faqs.answer: Verified tools can embed live status badges by visiting their tool detail page or badge page at https://nologin.tools/badge/ and copying the SVG embed snippet.
